SELECT 'overall' as period, cls, count(*) n, count(distinct boat) nboats, count(distinct fish_date_doy) ndays, round(sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers),3) ypa
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy<=90
GROUP BY cls
UNION ALL
SELECT 'last21d' as period, cls, count(*) n, count(distinct boat) nboats, count(distinct fish_date_doy) ndays, round(sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers),3) ypa
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 70 AND 90
GROUP BY cls
ORDER BY period, ypa DESC

SELECT cls, boat, count(*) n, round(avg(anglers),1) avg_anglers, round(sum(yt)*1.0/sum(anglers),3) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND fish_date_doy<=90 AND cls IN ('day_1_5','three_quarter')
GROUP BY cls, boat
HAVING count(*)>=3
ORDER BY cls, ypa DESC
SELECT * FROM climate WHERE avail_season=6 ORDER BY avail_doy DESC LIMIT 6
